headline: Anatomy of a poster
textNote: Edit the headline in the fixture. The new words flow into the HTML heading on the next render.
artNote: Choose another illustration for the hero slot. Its transparent edges let the page show through.
recipeNote: In Node.js, the nutrition recipe combines the words and images into one scene. The HTML export turns style properties such as the leaf’s width and position into CSS.
outputNote: With either backend, the engine can also export the fitted scene as offline HTML with selectable text and embedded artwork.
satoriNote: Satori lays out the scene and draws it as SVG. For PNG output, resvg rasterizes that SVG.
chromiumNote: Playwright opens the styled HTML in Chromium. The browser lays out the page and captures a PNG.
